description:
Find the products carrying one or more barcodes (GTIN, EAN or UPC) at Aldi, Tesco, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores and Lidl in one call: what a scanned or printed code is, and its price at each shop that lists it. Needs a signed-in BasketWatch account.

Returns products (each with its store, matched_barcodes, name, brand, pack_size, price and its full barcodes list), not_found and invalid. One credit per barcode found, however many retailers stock it; codes with no match cost nothing.

codes.description: One barcode or up to 100 (GTIN, EAN or UPC), as a list or separated by commas, written as printed: leading zeros, spaces and hyphens are ignored. E.g. '5000127014084'.

include_copy.description: True to add each product's ingredients and nutrition per 100g where the shop publishes them.

store.description: One shop to look in only that one: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl. Leave it out for all five.

name: lookup_barcode

left.description: Credits left on the account after it
left.title: Left

note.description: Said when the balance is low, or when it cut this answer short
note.title: Note

used.description: Credits this answer cost: one for each record it returned
used.title: Used

available.description: 0 when the shop shows it as out of stock; left out when it is in stock
available.title: Available

clubcard_price.description: Member price where one applies: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_price.title: Clubcard Price

first_seen.description: The first day the shop listed it: given for a newly listed product
first_seen.title: First Seen

id.description: The shop's own product id, e.g. tesco:12345 (an Aldi id has no shop in front): the form a product_ids parameter takes
id.title: Id

last_price.description: Its price on that last day
last_price.title: Last Price

last_seen.description: The last day the shop listed it: given for a product that has left its range
last_seen.title: Last Seen

name.description: Product name as the shop lists it
name.title: Name

offer_text.description: The offer as the shop words it
offer_text.title: Offer Text

price.description: Shelf price in euro: what anyone pays
price.title: Price

price_per_kg.description: unit_price worked out per kilo, where the shop prices the product by weight: the figure to compare packs of different sizes on (per kilo drained, where unit_basis says drained weight)
price_per_kg.title: Price Per Kg

price_per_litre.description: unit_price worked out per litre, where the shop prices the product by volume
price_per_litre.title: Price Per Litre

removed.description: 1 when it has left the shop's online range; left out when it is on sale
removed.title: Removed

scrape_date.description: The day this row's price was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD: given when it is not the answer's as_of
scrape_date.title: Scrape Date

shelf_path.description: Where the retailer shelves it, every level, e.g. 'Fresh Food > Yoghurts > Kefir > Kefir Drinks'
shelf_path.title: Shelf Path

store.description: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl
store.title: Store

unit_basis.description: The measure unit_price is in, as the shop states it: '1 KG', '100g', '75cl', 'each'
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

unit_price.description: The shop's own unit price, in the measure unit_basis names: per kg at one shop, per 100g or per 75cl at another, so as it stands it does not compare across rows
unit_price.title: Unit Price

was_price.description: The price the shop says it was before the offer
was_price.title: Was Price

credits.description: What this answer cost the person's BasketWatch account and what is left. Missing on a free answer

invalid.description: Codes that are not a barcode
invalid.title: Invalid

matched.description: How many of the codes asked for were found
matched.title: Matched

products.description: Every shop's product carrying one of the codes, each with matched_barcodes and its full barcodes list
products.title: Products

title: Look up products by barcode
